{{Quote|Now we raise the stakes and force our enemies to commit their elite. I've thus employed the Bane Brigade, the finest Imperial fighters of the last war.|Khun Tazith|<ref name="RotBB">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Revenge of the Bane Brigade|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>}}
The '''Bane Brigade''' was a military unit that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] by the time of the [[Great Galactic War]]. This unit was created by [[Khun Tazith]] who was noted to have nurtured the men and women that served within the brigade during their operations against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Tazith was also involved in planning their mission assignments and the unit became an elite force within the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] and were led by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] commanders into battle.

Amongst their achievements saw them purge a [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Genarius]] and set fire to the seas of [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]]. These missions saw the Republic refer to the Bane Brigade as butchers and war criminals. Their campaigns saw the members of the Bane Brigade receive replacement limbs with Tazith sitting beside them during such moments. One of their missions saw the brigade deployed onto [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] where they attacked a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] encampment and slaughtered its inhabitants. However, the unit lingered too long at the site which allowed the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to respond with an aerial strike that destroyed the entirety of the Bane Brigade thus defeating them. The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Shodarra]] who served in the Republic forces was noted to have witnessed the destruction of the Bane Brigade and believed that none could have survived the attack on them. Tazith was noted to have wept for the death of his men though the units men and women died as heroes to the Sith Empire.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Sith staged an assault to seemingly capture the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. This saw the Republic mobilize to combat the Empire in order to retain control of the planet. However, this was a ruse by the Sith Empire who intended to sap the Galactic Republic's resources on a worthless planet. To further ensure this goal, [[Special Advisor to the Minister of War]] Khun Tazith started a secret project with the aid of an imperial spacer to make it appear that the Bane Brigade was alive and operating on Hoth. The operation was noted to have been such a success that [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Graich]] of the Imperial military came to believe that the Brigade still lived and would obliterate the [[Republic Army]] on Hoth.

The ultimate goal of Tazith's plan was to bring about the arrival of the Republic's elite forces that would have been redeployed to fight the phantom Bane Brigade. These enemy forces were intended to fight the suspected Brigade's operations in [[Clabburn Tundra]] though in actuality these were cannon fodder that were expendable. Once there, the Republic attackers would have been killed when the Clabburn was brought down upon them. As such, the brutal strikes conducted by the imperial spacer succeeded in attracting their enemy's attention and their belief in the Bane Brigade's continued existence with projections of morale plummeting within the Republic forces. An intercepted Republic holocall saw [[General/Legends|General]] [[Uchang]] report that the Bane Brigade was still alive though General Shodarra doubted this on the basis that he saw them die years ago. General [[Krepkit]] urged his comrades to investigate this finding as the Brigade destroyed his people's capital in the past.

As a result, the operation was a success and the Empire determined that [[Republic Special Forces Division]] and members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were dispatched as part of the elite response from the Galactic Republic. Thus, Tazith prepared for their arrival and his trap for them at Clabburn Tundra. With the spacer's mission complete, Special Advisor Tazith congratulated them and stated that through them the myth of the Bane Brigade would live on.
